crossRefs.note: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet, and begged him to come…
He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each…
The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of…
Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Mary
people.line: Sister of Martha and Lazarus, sat at Jesus' feet.

translations.web: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
translations.bsb: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
translations.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
translations.asv: Mary therefore, when she came where Jesus was, and saw him, fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
